title: Migrate graph source root and projections
summary: Move generated graph/read-model ownership from src/state graph compatibility paths toward src/graph while keeping graph projection non-canonical.

goal.outcome: Generated graph/read-model code is owned by src/graph while generated graph remains a projection over canonical roadmap/trace/KB/source truth.
acceptance: src/graph/** contains graph builder/views/reader/type entrypoints or direct owner modules for generated graph behavior.
src/state graph compatibility code is migrated, retired, or documented with owner/trigger evidence.
Graph projections continue to expose planning coverage and execution metadata without becoming canonical truth.
Tests cover graph lenses/projections and source-contract expectations for the graph root.
No canonical roadmap, trace, or KB truth is moved into generated graph files.
non_goals: Do not implement planning or implementation root migration.
Do not add CodeWiki-repo-specific dogfood behavior.
verification: targeted TASK-119 graph root migration test

delta.desired: src/graph owns generated graph/read-model behavior and compatibility state paths are accounted for.
delta.current: Graph/read-model code lives under src/state/** compatibility paths while accepted target root is src/graph/**.
delta.closure: Closed when graph root exists with projection tests and source-contract evidence.
